strings.界面语言；切换后重启软件生效: UI language; restart the app to apply
strings.这里显示当前生效键位；改键后本页会同步。: Shows the active shortcuts; this page follows key changes.
strings.设置条一直摊开（触摸屏不用去碰那条色线）: Keep the settings band open (no need to hit the thin color line on touch screens)
strings.工具带和面板的大小；点一下换一档（0.8～1.3，五档）: Size of the toolbar and panels; click to cycle through 0.8–1.3 (five steps)
strings.关掉后所有笔迹等宽（手写板照样流畅）: Turn off to make all strokes the same width (pen input stays smooth)
strings.开了让墨尾更跟手一点；默认关，想跟手就在这里打开: Makes the ink tail follow a little faster; off by default
strings.只在桌面批注时生效：点箭头进入穿透前，先清空桌面上的批注（可 Ctrl+Z 撤销: Desktop annotation only: clear desktop ink before click-through (undoable with Ctrl+Z)
strings.手势 = 双指翻页/缩放 + 三指擦 + 长按选择；单指 = 只允许一个触点写字: Gestures = two-finger scroll/zoom + three-finger erase + long-press select; one finger = writing only, no gestures
strings.只上传安装量、版本、硬件/性能和触摸统计；不含姓名、账号、课件或屏幕内容；可随时: Uploads install count, version, hardware/performance and touch statistics only; no names, accounts, slides or screen content; can be disabled anytime
strings.配置板书识别用的服务地址 / API Key / 模型；可添加多个服务商，选中一: Configure the service URL / API key / model for board recognition; multiple providers are supported
strings.下次启动接上这次的板书: Restore this board on next launch
strings.PPT 放映 / 文档打开时，批注按页自动保存、下次自动装载: While presenting or viewing a document, save annotations per page and reload them next time
strings.过期 PPT 缓存 / 打开前备份 / 历史板书，启动时清掉: Clean expired slide caches, pre-open backups and board history at startup
strings.收藏 / 历史板书 / 设置 / 课件批注打包成 .zip；不含 PDF / P: Pack favorites, board history, settings and slide annotations into a .zip; PDF/PPT originals are not included
strings.选备份包；恢复后重启软件生效，旧数据留在 .before-restore: Choose a backup; restart to apply, old data is kept in .before-restore
strings.登录 Windows 后在后台待命：点小球再开始批注: Wait in the background after Windows sign-in; click the ball to start annotating
strings.PNG 图片（透明底 · 贴课件首选，无损）: PNG image (transparent, lossless, best for slides)
strings.挑工具：切到「自定义」档，这里就能钉 / 取消钉: Choose tools: switch to Custom to pin or unpin them here
strings.图片 JPG（白底 · 好发微信）: JPG image (white background, easy to share)
strings.板书文件 (*.inkb · 以后可再打开): Board file (*.inkb, can be reopened later)
strings.打开文档（图片可多选；PPT 直接放映）: Open document (multi-select images; PPT opens directly)
strings.打开文档（图片可多选，PPT 直接放映）: Open document (multi-select images, PPT opens directly)
strings.选笔，或直接用手写笔 / 鼠标写。\nCtrl+P 切笔。:
Pick a pen, or write with a stylus / mouse.
Press Ctrl+P to switch pens.
strings.点「鼠标」格，或按\nCtrl+Alt+Shift+T；再按一次回到画笔。:
Click the Mouse cell, or press
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T; press again to return to the pen.
strings.按住 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q，\n划向扇区，松手；中心取消。:
Hold Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q,
flick to a sector and release; the center cancels.
strings.Ctrl+Z 撤销；橡皮擦局部；\nCtrl+Shift+C 清空当前板书。:
Ctrl+Z to undo; the eraser removes locally;
Ctrl+Shift+C clears the current board.
strings.首次弹窗选择；设置 → 书写可改。\n不含姓名、账号、课件或屏幕内容。:
Chosen in the first prompt; change it in Settings → Writing.
No names, accounts, slides or screen content.
strings.底部 = 工具带；工具上方 = 当前设置；右下「更多」= 文件 / 课堂 / 设:
Bottom = toolbar; above it = current settings; “More” at bottom right = files / classroom / settings.
When PPT / whiteboard / document is open, a page bar appears at the bottom.
strings.只允许一个触点写字，无手势: Only one contact writes; no gestures
strings.直接写字，和鼠标一样: Write directly, just like with a mouse
strings.手势模式：滚动画布 / 翻一页: Gesture mode: scroll canvas / flip a page
strings.手势模式：呼出工具轮盘: Gesture mode: open the tool wheel
strings.回到画笔（点穿透格 / 全局键）: Return to the pen (click-through cell / global key)
strings.手势模式：双指上下 = 滚动，左右 = 翻页；三指 = 擦；轮盘中心 = 取消。:
Gesture mode: two fingers up/down = scroll, left/right = flip; three fingers = erase; wheel center = cancel.
One-finger mode has no gestures; area/palm erase is gone; use the stroke/pixel eraser in the toolbar.
strings.倒计时 / 正计时 / 秒表；卡片可拖动、双击放大: Countdown / stopwatch; the card can be dragged and double-clicked to enlarge
strings.全名单，抽过的不重复；范围可设: Full class list, no repeats; range can be set
strings.自动抽一个，1.5 秒自动关: Picks one automatically and closes after 1.5 s
strings.整份板书存成 .inkb，或存成图片（jpg / png，好发微信）: Save the whole board as .inkb or an image (jpg / png, easy to share)
strings.打开板书(.inkb) / 图片 / PDF / PPT；图片可多选: Open a board (.inkb) / image / PDF / PPT; multiple images can be selected
strings.关掉当前文档；批注留在画布上: Close the current document; annotations stay on the canvas
strings.找回以前写在**白板**上的墨迹（自动留存，停手时写；不含截图）: Recover ink previously written on the **whiteboard** (auto-saved when you stop; no screenshots)
strings.语音/文字出题；1A 先出示例题卡（不联网）: Create questions by voice/text; 1A shows sample cards (offline)
strings.开发中：AI 出题先暂停，等新想法后再开放: In development: AI quiz is paused until the next design
strings.4 步上手 / 手势 / 快捷键；F1 也能打开: 4-step start / gestures / shortcuts; F1 also opens it
strings.上传运行日志给开发；加群反馈也在这里: Upload logs to the developer; feedback group is here too
strings.收藏里删掉的东西会先来这里；点卡片恢复: Deleted favorites arrive here first; click a card to restore it
strings.把卡片拖到页签，或点 ☰ → 导入图片: Drag a card to a tab, or click ☰ → Import image
strings.选中对象 → 收藏；透明贴纸点 ☰ → 导入图片: Select an object → Favorites; for transparent stickers click ☰ → Import image
strings.点页码：页码跳转菜单: Click page number: page jump menu
